notes: University layer: UIUC has no single campus AI policy; CITL's 'Integrate AI into your Teaching' is the campus teaching-center guidance. The University of Illinois System's 'Generative AI Guidance for Instructors' (https://www.vpaa.uillinois.edu/digital_risk_management/generative_ai/instructors), linked from CITL and Grainger, is behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403) and is INACCESSIBLE; it is system-level, not campus-level. Student Code Article 1 Part 4 (1-402) has no AI-specific text. genai.illinois.edu is a CIO tools/resources hub (excluded). genai.grainger.illinois.edu returns an intermittent IIS server error to fetch_text's user agent; both Grainger files were re-fetched until the full page saved. The Grainger guidance page embeds template tiers plus example course statements (BIOE 415 referenced, CS 411, NIU). Computing layer: no unit-level policy found for the Siebel School of Computing and Data Science, ECE, or the iSchool. Course layer: CS 124 has two documents (dedicated AI page and Fall 2026 syllabus) counted as one course. Also checked: CS 225 syllabus page (https://courses.grainger.illinois.edu/cs225/fa2026/policy/syllabus/, one-line AI rule, saved as v2-uiuc-cs225-syl but not listed), CS 173 (landing page only), CS 233 (PrairieLearn login), ECE 120 (HTTP 500). No other public iSchool syllabi with AI policies found.
